method: Built-in image_gen. Single-direction 8-pose replacements for six failed leading-foot audits. Head-only identity crops and explicit limb guides; no final art pixels synthesized by scripts. Rowan's rear cloak covers equipment to avoid mirrored accessories. Rejected rear accessory repair retained only under generated_images.

assets.prompt: Use case: game sprite asset. Build EXACTLY EIGHT FRONT-FACING (south) complete full-body WALK poses of Aren in a four-column x two-row atlas. ALL eight face viewer. Read row-major 1,2,3,4 then5,6,7,8. Image1 is a strict anatomical guide; copy EACH guide's limb/foot pose exactly, without copying guide colors. Image2 shows only Aren's identity/head, NEVER a leg stance. Keep his brown spiky hair, blue eyes, red scarf, teal leather tunic with cream short hem, brown trousers, two brown boots, sword SHEATHED on one hip, hands empty. Both arms counter-swing against legs, scarf follows through. Crucial: in poses1-4 the viewer-RIGHT boot hangs LOWER, viewer-LEFT knee is lifted; in poses5-8 the viewer-LEFT boot hangs LOWER and viewer-RIGHT knee lifts. Specifically pose1 RIGHT boot on bottom baseline and LEFT boot visibly 12pixels higher. Pose5 LEFT boot on bottom baseline and RIGHT boot 12pixels higher. The two halves MUST exchange legs, not repeat the same lifted leg. Every boot stays on its own side of the pelvis, with a dark/transparent gap between legs, both shin/boot shapes clearly visible. Alternate weight, passing poses and opposite contact over8frames. Keep torso, head, outfit size and character identity stable, crisp detailed original HD-2D pixel clusters matching Image2. Full character only central60% of each cell, ample blank transparent gutters, head/feet never cropped. Transparent alpha background, no shadows/text/grids, landscape1536x768. Do not draw a ninth character.

Use case: original game sprite asset. EXACTLY EIGHT whole-body WALK poses in FOUR COLUMNS x TWO ROWS, read row-major1,2,3,4 then5,6,7,8. All eight face the SAME DIRECTION specified below, not different views. Image1 is a strict limb guide; follow its separate leg/foot positions for EACH corresponding cell. Image2 is the character's head/identity/color style; body described below. Match the reference's LARGE chibi head at approximately HALF of entire sprite height; very short torso, clearly readable two shins/boots below hem. This is the same game's art continuity, NOT a different realistic human design. Every pose exactly two arms, TWO SEPARATE LEG LANES and TWO BOOTS. In first half1-4 one leg lifts/passes, in second half5-8 the OTHER leg lifts/passes. Pose1 and5 must have opposite boots at the bottom baseline; the other boot is visibly 10-12pixels HIGHER. Do not repeat one leading leg for all8. Stable head/hip center, coordinated opposite arm swing, cloth/hair one-frame lag. Keep consistent face and head proportions, palette, outfit and body scale; eyes open throughout. Crisp beautiful detailed HD-2D pixel clusters, clean silhouettes. Full character takes only central60%width and70%height of each cell, generous empty gutters. Transparent alpha, no shadows/text/grid/scenery. Landscape1536x768. The same character in8 distinct walking stages.
